deviations.what: ReviewQueueView sets its own template_name (review/queue.html) and its row template is included with Django's {% include %} rather than rendered through FairDMListView's stock render_list_item item-card mechanism.
deviations.why: render_list_item calls render_to_string(template_name, new) with a plain dict, no request — so {% csrf_token %} inside a card rendered that way has no token in its context and a form built there fails CSRF validation on every submission, silently. The queue's rows carry two POST forms per assessment (approve, send back), so this mattered here in a way it never has for ReviewListView's read-only card. {% include %} inherits the parent template's real request context instead.
